name: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. IV
summary: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. IV currently conducts no substantial business operations. Its core mission involves executing a strategic business combination, which may take various forms such as a merger, acquisition, share exchange, or reorganization, with one or more enterprises. The company specifically targets businesses operating within the biotechnology, healthcare, and technology sectors. Established in 2025, Blue Water Acquisition Corp. IV is headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut.
